title: Session 10: Views, Stored Procedures, and Querying Metadata — SQL Server

questions.questionText: A view is:
options: A virtual table made up of selected columns from one or more tables
A physical copy of a table
questions.correctAnswer: A virtual table made up of selected columns from one or more tables
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: A virtual table made up of selected columns from one or more tables.

questions.questionText: The tables from which a view is created are called:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Base tables.

questions.questionText: What is the maximum number of columns a view can have?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: 1,024.

questions.questionText: Which statement creates a view?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: CREATE VIEW.

questions.questionText: A view can be created only in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: The current database.

questions.questionText: Per recommended coding conventions, view names are prefixed with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: vw.

questions.questionText: Which statement removes a view?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: DROP VIEW.

questions.questionText: When a view is dropped, the data in the base tables:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Remains unaffected.

questions.questionText: Which statement modifies the definition of a view?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: ALTER VIEW.

questions.questionText: If columns are added to a base table after a view is created, the new columns:
options: Do not appear in the view until it is altered
questions.correctAnswer: Do not appear in the view until it is altered
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Do not appear in the view until it is altered.

questions.questionText: An INSERT through a view built on two base tables will:
options: Fail because the view is not updatable
Insert only in the first table
questions.correctAnswer: Fail because the view is not updatable
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Fail because the view is not updatable.

questions.questionText: Which clause is used to modify a section of a large-value data type column through an UPDATE?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: .WRITE.

questions.questionText: The .WRITE clause cannot be used to:
options: Update a NULL value in a column
questions.correctAnswer: Update a NULL value in a column
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Update a NULL value in a column.

questions.questionText: A column with the IDENTITY property:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Cannot have its value updated.

questions.questionText: Records cannot be updated through a view if the base table contains a column of type:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: TIMESTAMP.

questions.questionText: Rows deleted from a view are:
options: Also deleted from the base table
questions.correctAnswer: Also deleted from the base table
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Also deleted from the base table.

questions.questionText: Which view option ensures all modifications through the view satisfy the view's WHERE conditions?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: WITH CHECK OPTION.

questions.questionText: WITH CHECK OPTION enforces:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Domain integrity.

questions.questionText: Updates made directly to base tables are verified against the view's CHECK OPTION:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: No, they are not verified.

questions.questionText: Which option prevents base tables from being modified in a way that affects the view definition?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: SCHEMABINDING.

questions.questionText: When using SCHEMABINDING, the object names must be specified with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Two-part names (schema name included).

questions.questionText: A table that is schema-bound to a view can be dropped only if:
options: The view is dropped or altered to remove schema binding
questions.correctAnswer: The view is dropped or altered to remove schema binding
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: The view is dropped or altered to remove schema binding.

questions.questionText: Which stored procedure refreshes the metadata of a view after the base table changes?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: sp_refreshview.

questions.questionText: Which stored procedure displays the definition of a view (if not encrypted)?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: sp_helptext.

questions.questionText: A stored procedure is:
options: A group of Transact-SQL statements stored in the database as a single named block
questions.correctAnswer: A group of Transact-SQL statements stored in the database as a single named block
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: A group of Transact-SQL statements stored in the database as a single named block.

questions.questionText: Stored procedures are stored in the database in which form?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Compiled form.

questions.questionText: One advantage of stored procedures is:
options: Reduced network traffic because only the call is sent
questions.correctAnswer: Reduced network traffic because only the call is sent
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Reduced network traffic because only the call is sent.

questions.questionText: Stored procedures can accept values through:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Input parameters.

questions.questionText: Values are returned from a stored procedure to the caller using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Output parameters.

questions.questionText: Which keyword marks a parameter as an output parameter?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: OUTPUT.

questions.questionText: Which stored procedures are created by users and are also called custom stored procedures?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: User-defined stored procedures.

questions.questionText: System stored procedures have the prefix:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: sp_.

questions.questionText: System stored procedures are physically stored in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: The Resource database.

questions.questionText: Which stored procedures are used for temporary use within a session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Temporary stored procedures.

questions.questionText: Which stored procedures run on remote SQL Servers?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Remote stored procedures.

questions.questionText: Extended stored procedures are used to:
options: Perform tasks that cannot be done with standard Transact-SQL
questions.correctAnswer: Perform tasks that cannot be done with standard Transact-SQL
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Perform tasks that cannot be done with standard Transact-SQL.

questions.questionText: Which keyword in ALTER PROCEDURE forces the procedure to be compiled at run-time?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: RECOMPILE.

questions.questionText: When a stored procedure is altered, its permissions:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Remain the same.

questions.questionText: Which statement removes a stored procedure?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: DROP PROCEDURE.

questions.questionText: When a stored procedure calls another stored procedure, the nesting level:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Increases by one.

questions.questionText: Metadata is:
options: Data about data, such as properties of tables and views
questions.correctAnswer: Data about data, such as properties of tables and views
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Data about data, such as properties of tables and views.

questions.questionText: Which views contain information about the catalog in a SQL Server system?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Catalog views.

questions.questionText: Which views are ANSI-standard views useful to third-party tools for querying system metadata?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Information schema views.

questions.questionText: Which of the following returns server and database state information to monitor the health of a server instance?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Dynamic Management Views (DMVs).

questions.questionText: To query DMVs, a user must have:
options: VIEW SERVER STATE or VIEW DATABASE STATE permission
questions.correctAnswer: VIEW SERVER STATE or VIEW DATABASE STATE permission
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: VIEW SERVER STATE or VIEW DATABASE STATE permission.

questions.questionText: Which DMV displays information about all active user connections and internal tasks at server scope?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: sys.dm_exec_sessions.

questions.questionText: System functions such as scalar and table-valued functions can be used to:
options: Return information about system state and metadata
questions.correctAnswer: Return information about system state and metadata
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Return information about system state and metadata.

questions.questionText: Which view type presents data that is NOT physically stored but computed when referenced?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: A standard view.

questions.questionText: A view can include columns from:
options: Tables and other views, from the same or different databases
questions.correctAnswer: Tables and other views, from the same or different databases
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Tables and other views, from the same or different databases.

questions.questionText: To create a view, a user must have:
options: Permission to access the underlying tables and views
questions.correctAnswer: Permission to access the underlying tables and views
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Permission to access the underlying tables and views.

questions.questionText: Which command lets a user execute a stored procedure?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: EXECUTE (EXEC).

questions.questionText: A benefit of using a view is that it:
options: Can restrict users to specific columns and rows of data
questions.correctAnswer: Can restrict users to specific columns and rows of data
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Can restrict users to specific columns and rows of data.

questions.questionText: The CHECK OPTION is associated with which statement?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: CREATE VIEW.
